name: allowedUrls
description: URLs or domains allowed without prompting. Supports exact URLs, domain patterns, and wildcard subdomains (for example, "*.github.com").
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented allowedUrls behavior.

name: askUser
description: Allow the agent to ask clarifying questions. Set to false for fully autonomous operation. Can also be set with --no-ask-user.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented askUser behavior.

name: autoUpdate
description: Automatically download CLI updates and update first-party plugins at the start of each session.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented autoUpdate behavior.

name: autoUpdatesChannel
description: "stable"
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented autoUpdatesChannel behavior.

name: banner
description: "never"
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented banner behavior.

name: bashEnv
description: Enable BASH_ENV support for bash shells. Can also be set with --bash-env or --no-bash-env.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented bashEnv behavior.

name: beep
description: Play an audible beep when attention is required.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented beep behavior.

name: beepOnSchedule
description: Play an audible beep when a scheduled /every or /after run finishes.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented beepOnSchedule behavior.

name: builtInAgents.rubberDuck
description: Enable the rubber-duck subagent that provides adversarial feedback on agent plans.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented builtInAgents.rubberDuck behavior.

name: builtInAgents.rubberDuckAutoInvoke
description: Include proactive prompting for automatic rubber-duck invocation. Set to true to opt into additional rubber-duck nudges during agent turns.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented builtInAgents.rubberDuckAutoInvoke behavior.

name: colorMode
description: "dim" \
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented colorMode behavior.

name: commandHistoryMaxSize
description: Maximum number of recent commands retained for input history and reverse search. Must be an integer between 1 and 1000.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented commandHistoryMaxSize behavior.

name: compactPaste
description: Collapse large pastes (more than 10 lines) into compact tokens.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented compactPaste behavior.

name: companyAnnouncements
description: Messages shown randomly on startup.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented companyAnnouncements behavior.

name: continueOnAutoMode
description: Automatically switch to auto mode when rate-limited. When true, eligible rate limit errors trigger an automatic switch to auto mode and retry. Does not apply to global rate limits or BYOK providers.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented continueOnAutoMode behavior.

name: copyOnSelect
description: Automatically copy mouse-selected text to the system clipboard.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented copyOnSelect behavior.

name: customAgents.defaultLocalOnly
description: Only use local custom agents (no remote organization or enterprise agents).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented customAgents.defaultLocalOnly behavior.

conditions: Only use local custom agents (no remote organization or enterprise agents).

name: deniedUrls
description: URLs or domains blocked.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented deniedUrls behavior.

name: disableAllHooks
description: Disable all hooks.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented disableAllHooks behavior.

name: disabledMcpServers
description: MCP servers configured but not started.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented disabledMcpServers behavior.

name: disabledSkills
description: Skills discovered but not loaded.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented disabledSkills behavior.

name: dynamicRetrieval
description: Per-category control of embeddings-based dynamic instruction retrieval. Set skills to false to disable retrieval for skills.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented dynamicRetrieval behavior.

name: effortLevel
description: Pin the default reasoning effort.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented effortLevel behavior.

name: enabledMcpServers
description: Enable built-in MCP servers that are disabled by default.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented enabledMcpServers behavior.

name: enabledPlugins
description: Declarative plugin auto-install.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented enabledPlugins behavior.

name: experimental
description: Enable experimental features. Can also be enabled with the --experimental command-line option or the /experimental slash command.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented experimental behavior.

name: extraKnownMarketplaces
description: Plugin marketplaces available in this repository. Each entry's source is required. An autoUpdate: true on an entry is accepted at the repository level but currently ignored—the auto-update opt-in is only honored when set in the user's own settings or in managed (MDM/server) settings.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented extraKnownMarketplaces behavior.

name: footer
description: Controls which items appear in the status line. Sub-keys include showModelEffort, showDirectory, showBranch, showContextWindow, showQuota, showAgent, showAiUsed, showCodeChanges, showUsername, showSandbox, showYolo, and showCustom (all boolean). Managed by the /statusline slash command.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented footer behavior.

name: hooks
description: Hook definitions scoped to this repository. See Using hooks with GitHub Copilot CLI.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented hooks behavior.

name: ide.autoConnect
description: Automatically connect to an IDE workspace on startup. When false, you can still connect manually using the /ide command.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented ide.autoConnect behavior.

name: ide.openDiffOnEdit
description: Open file edit diffs in the connected IDE for approval. When false, file edit approvals are shown only in the terminal.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented ide.openDiffOnEdit behavior.

name: includeCoAuthoredBy
description: Add a Co-authored-by trailer to commits.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented includeCoAuthoredBy behavior.

name: keepAlive
description: "busy"
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented keepAlive behavior.

name: logLevel
description: "warning" \
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented logLevel behavior.

name: mergeStrategy
description: Replaced—repository takes precedence
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented mergeStrategy behavior.

name: mouse
description: Enable mouse support. Can also be set with --mouse or --no-mouse.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented mouse behavior.

name: permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode
description: Set to "disable" to suppress all allow-all flags (--allow-all-tools, --allow-all-paths, --allow-all-urls, --allow-all, --yolo) at startup so they cannot be used to grant elevated permissions. Set to "allow-auto-only" to keep blocking full allow-all while still permitting /allow-all auto (LLM-assisted auto-approval). See GitHub Copilot CLI command reference.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode behavior.

name: pinnedPrompts
description: Pin the current section's user prompt just below the top bar while scrolling the timeline, so it stays clear which request the visible output belongs to. CLI UI only—has no effect on prompts sent to the model.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented pinnedPrompts behavior.

name: powershellFlags
description: Flags passed to PowerShell on startup. On Windows, the CLI prefers PowerShell 7+ (pwsh) and falls back to Windows PowerShell (powershell.exe) when pwsh is unavailable. Windows only.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented powershellFlags behavior.

conditions: Flags passed to PowerShell on startup. On Windows, the CLI prefers PowerShell 7+ (pwsh) and falls back to Windows PowerShell (powershell.exe) when pwsh is unavailable. Windows only.

name: proxyKerberosServicePrincipal
description: Service principal name (SPN) for Kerberos/Negotiate proxy authentication, overriding the derived HTTP/.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented proxyKerberosServicePrincipal behavior.

name: proxyUrl
description: Proxy URL for HTTP(S) requests (for example, http://proxy.corp.example:3128). Overridden by the HTTP_PROXY or HTTPS_PROXY environment variables (any casing).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented proxyUrl behavior.

name: remote
description: "on"
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented remote behavior.

name: renderHexColors
description: Show six-digit hex color codes written as inline code (for example, #FF0000 ) as color swatches.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented renderHexColors behavior.

name: renderMarkdown
description: Render Markdown in terminal output.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented renderMarkdown behavior.

name: remoteExport
description: Export sessions remotely when session sync is available. Set to false to opt out of remote export by default. The remoteSessions setting when set to true, or the --remote flag, still enables export and steering regardless of this setting.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented remoteExport behavior.

name: respectGitignore
description: Exclude gitignored files from the @ file mention picker.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented respectGitignore behavior.

name: sandbox.allowBypass
description: Allow sandboxed commands to request a bypass for specific operations (surfaces a permission prompt) so tools like grep and glob keep working when the sandbox would otherwise block them. Set to false to opt out.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented sandbox.allowBypass behavior.

name: sandbox.auth.git
description: Inject Git credentials into the sandbox so commands running inside it can authenticate with Git. Set to false to opt out. Renamed from sandbox.gitAuth; the old key has no migration and is ignored wherever it still appears.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented sandbox.auth.git behavior.

name: sandbox.auth.gh
description: Inject GitHub CLI (gh) credentials into the sandbox so commands running inside it can authenticate with the GitHub CLI. Set to false to opt out. Renamed from sandbox.ghAuth; the old key has no migration and is ignored wherever it still appears.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented sandbox.auth.gh behavior.

name: sandbox.userPolicy.network.allowLocalNetwork
description: Allow sandboxed commands to reach local network addresses (for example, local dev servers). Set to false to opt out.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented sandbox.userPolicy.network.allowLocalNetwork behavior.

name: sandbox.userPolicy.network.proxy
description: Route sandboxed network traffic through an HTTP proxy. Fields: url (required), username (optional), password (optional). Configure it from the /sandbox dialog's Network tab, which masks the password field. The password itself is stored in the OS keychain rather than in settings.json, so it isn't editable via /settings. On Linux and macOS the proxy is cooperative (not strictly enforced); Windows enforces it.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented sandbox.userPolicy.network.proxy behavior.

name: sandbox.userPolicy.deniedPaths
description: Paths that sandboxed commands are denied access to. On Windows, the ProcessContainer sandbox backend cannot enforce per-path deny rules, so entries have no effect—therefore don't rely on deniedPaths to protect a sensitive directory on Windows.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented sandbox.userPolicy.deniedPaths behavior.

name: sandbox.userPolicy.seatbelt.keychainAccess
description: macOS only. Grant sandboxed commands access to the system keychain. Can also be toggled from the /sandbox dialog.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented sandbox.userPolicy.seatbelt.keychainAccess behavior.

conditions: macOS only. Grant sandboxed commands access to the system keychain. Can also be toggled from the /sandbox dialog.

name: screenReader
description: Enable screen reader optimizations.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented screenReader behavior.

name: scrollbar
description: Show the scrollbar in scrollable views. Set to false to hide it and use the full terminal width.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented scrollbar behavior.

name: shellShortcut
description: Let a lone $ at the prompt, followed by Enter, open an interactive shell rooted at the session's working directory (activates only for a local, trusted, idle session on a real TTY). User- or managed-scoped only—not repo-overridable.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented shellShortcut behavior.

name: showTimestamps
description: Show dim HH:mm timestamps next to user messages in the timeline.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented showTimestamps behavior.

name: showTipsOnStartup
description: Show a random command tip when the CLI starts.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented showTipsOnStartup behavior.

name: skillDirectories
description: Additional directories to search for custom skill definitions (in addition to ~/.copilot/skills/).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented skillDirectories behavior.

name: statusLine
description: Custom status line display. type: must be "command". command: path to an executable script that receives session JSON on stdin and prints status content to stdout. padding: optional number of left-padding spaces. refreshInterval: optional integer number of seconds (1–2147483) to re-run the command on a timer instead of only on events; omit it to refresh only when the session state changes. If the command fails to spawn, exits non-zero, or fails to receive the status JSON on stdin, the CLI logs a warning once per continuous failure episode and leaves the status line blank instead of failing silently. Run with --log-level all to see the underlying error detail.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented statusLine behavior.

name: stayInAutopilot
description: Remain in autopilot mode after each task completes. When enabled, the next prompt you enter after a task completes is also handled in autopilot mode. For more information, see Allowing GitHub Copilot CLI to work autonomously.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented stayInAutopilot behavior.

name: storeTokenPlaintext
description: Allow authentication tokens to be stored in plain text in config.json when no system keychain is available.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented storeTokenPlaintext behavior.

name: stream
description: Enable streaming responses.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented stream behavior.

name: streamerMode
description: Hide preview model names, quota details, prompt timestamps, and the update-available notice. Useful when demonstrating Copilot CLI or screen sharing.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented streamerMode behavior.

name: subagents.agents
description: Per-agent model configuration, keyed by agent name. Each value is an object with optional model (string), effortLevel (string), and contextTier ("default", "long_context", or "inherit") fields. Set any field to "inherit" to use the parent session's value at dispatch time. Use the /subagents slash command to configure these settings interactively.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented subagents.agents behavior.

name: subagents.disabledSubagents
description: Agent names to prevent from being dispatched. Only the rubber-duck agent cannot be disabled via this setting. All other built-in agents—including explore, task, code-review, general-purpose, research, and security-review—can be disabled.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented subagents.disabledSubagents behavior.

name: subagents.maxConcurrency
description: Maximum concurrent subagents for this session. Only honored for usage-based billing users; ignored for all other plans. Capped at 32. See GitHub Copilot CLI command reference.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented subagents.maxConcurrency behavior.

name: subagents.maxDepth
description: Maximum subagent nesting depth. Only honored for usage-based billing users; ignored for all other plans. Capped at 256. See GitHub Copilot CLI command reference.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented subagents.maxDepth behavior.

name: tabs.enabled
description: Show the home tab bar. Set to false to hide it entirely.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tabs.enabled behavior.

name: tabs.hide
description: Tab identifiers to hide. Accepted values: "copilot", "agents", "issues", "pull-requests", "gists" (matched case-insensitively).
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tabs.hide behavior.

name: tabs.sort
description: Order in which tabs are displayed. Tabs not listed keep their default relative order after the listed ones. Unknown identifiers are ignored.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented tabs.sort behavior.

name: terminalProgress
description: Emit OSC 9;4 terminal progress indicators while the agent is working. Supported terminals include Windows Terminal, iTerm2, Ghostty, and ConEmu.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented terminalProgress behavior.

name: theme
description: "dim" \
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented theme behavior.

name: toolSearch
description: Controls tool search (deferred tool loading). Set toolSearch: false to opt out of tool search.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented toolSearch behavior.

name: updateTerminalTitle
description: Show the current intent in the terminal tab or window title.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented updateTerminalTitle behavior.

name: contextTier

when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented contextTier behavior.

name: serverUrl
description: Supports * wildcards; scheme and host match case-insensitively, path case-sensitively. ${VAR} references expand before matching.
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented serverUrl behavior.

name: serverCommand

name: serverName
description: Allowlist entries are restricted to [A-Za-z0-9_-]+ (no wildcards); denylist entries accept any non-empty string.
syntax: serverName: <A server by its assigned label>
when_to_use: Set this option when you need the documented serverName behavior.
